title: Build failed on linking - MacOS
body:
### Tested versions

See below

### System information

MacOS Sonoma - Intel chip

### Issue description

The command `scons platform=macos arch=x86_64 generate_bundle=yes` in MacOS Sonoma gives the following output as a final step: (re-run after everything else is successfull):

```
scons: Reading SConscript files ...
Auto-detected 4 CPU cores available for build parallelism. Using 4 cores by default. You can override it with the `-j` or `num_jobs` arguments.
Building for macOS 10.13+.
WARNING: Target architecture 'x86_64' does not support the Metal rendering driver
MoltenVK found at: /Users/ivano/VulkanSDK/1.4.321/macOS/lib/MoltenVK.xcframework
Building for platform "macos", architecture "x86_64", target "editor".
scons: done reading SConscript files.
scons: Building targets ...
[100%] Linking Program bin/godot.macos.editor.x86_64 ...
[100%] ld: warning: object file (/Users/ivano/VulkanSDK/1.4.321/macOS/lib/MoltenVK.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libMoltenVK.a[x86_64][2](libMoltenVK.a-x86_64-master.o)) was built for newer 'macOS' version (10.15) than being linked (10.13)
Undefined symbols for architecture x86_64:
  "_OBJC_CLASS_$_MTLResidencySetDescriptor", referenced from:
       in libMoltenVK.a[x86_64][2](libMoltenVK.a-x86_64-master.o)
ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture x86_64
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
scons: *** [bin/godot.macos.editor.x86_64] Error 1
scons: building terminated because of errors.
INFO: Time elapsed: 00:00:26.17
```

And I don't have a clue on what's wrong. Please, help.

Thanks in advnce for any kind of support.
Regards, have a nice day.

Kindly, Ivano.

### Steps to reproduce

Just run scons build

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Jus run scons build from git downloaded source
